resources.string: Matches run only on the match date, spaced by this interval. The end time is included when it falls on the interval.
All matches open for registration from 12:00 AM on the release date, Bangladesh time. If that date has started, they open now. Keep the admin app signed in and online; past start times are skipped.
Matches are released together from midnight on the release date while the admin app is online. Reopen the app if Android stops it.
Release date must be on or before the match date.
Turn this on to create multiple matches on one date.
